operations.claim: write through pointer p into command buffer
write through pointer p into command buffer
parse formatted input from command buffer into bounds fields

states.claim: image is an acquired Image object; OpenBlob is called on it and it is destroyed on failure paths.
input_filename is established as a unique symbolic link path by AcquireUniqueSymbolicLink.
command is zero-initialized and p is set to point to the start of command.
p is advanced through command storage while reading bytes; when a delimiter or capacity limit is reached, p is reset to point to the start of command.
image is closed via CloseBlob after the PCL media box scan.
image is destroyed before cloning read_info.
read_info is a cloned ImageInfo object.
read_info->filename is replaced with a unique filename.
options is an allocated string that is destroyed after command formatting.
density is an allocated string that is destroyed after command formatting.
read_info->filename and input_filename are relinquished as unique file resources.
image is assigned the result of ReadImage(read_info,exception).
If image->magick is BMP, cmyk_image is obtained from ConsolidateCMYKImages; if non-NULL, image is destroyed and replaced by cmyk_image.
next_image is set to the next image in the list; if non-NULL, image is advanced to next_image.

values.claim: p is initialized to command and incremented by one per byte; the buffer is flushed when (size_t)(p-command) >= MagickPathExtent-1, so p-command stays within [0, MagickPathExtent-1] before the terminating NUL is written at *p.
command is a char array of MagickPathExtent bytes, zero-initialized before use.
width and height are computed from bounds.x2-bounds.x1 and bounds.y2-bounds.y1 via floor(...+0.5) and cast to size_t; negative differences would convert to large size_t values.
values.evidence:
L153: width=(size_t) floor(bounds.x2-bounds.x1+0.5);
L154: height=(size_t) floor(bounds.y2-bounds.y1+0.5);

values.claim: page.width and page.height are updated to the maximum of the current page dimensions and the computed width/height.
page.width and page.height are scaled by image->resolution.x/delta.x and image->resolution.y/delta.y respectively, then floored and cast to size_t.
geometry is formatted with page.width and page.height as doubles into a MagickPathExtent-sized buffer.
options is formatted with page.width and page.height as doubles into a MagickPathExtent-sized buffer.
command is formatted with the delegate command string and arguments (antialias values, density, options, read_info->filename, input_filename) into a MagickPathExtent-sized buffer.
values.evidence:
L214: (void) FormatLocaleString(command,MagickPathExtent,
L215: GetDelegateCommands(delegate_info),
L216: read_info->antialias != MagickFalse ? 4 : 1,
L217: read_info->antialias != MagickFalse ? 4 : 1,density,options,
L218: read_info->filename,input_filename);

values.claim: filename is copied from read_info->filename with a MagickPathExtent bound.
image->filename is copied from filename with a MagickPathExtent bound.
image->magick_columns, magick_rows, columns, and rows are multiplied by image->resolution.x/2.0 or image->resolution.y/2.0 when ping is set.
count is assigned the number of successfully scanned doubles (0-4) from sscanf into bounds.x1, bounds.y1, bounds.x2, bounds.y2; only count==4 proceeds to geometry computation.
density is formatted with image->resolution.x and image->resolution.y as %g into a MagickPathExtent-sized buffer, or overwritten with "2.0x2.0" when ping is set.
options is formatted with read_info->scene and read_info->number_scenes values into a MagickPathExtent-sized buffer when number_scenes is nonzero.

executions.claim: When count == 4, width and height are computed from bounds.x2-bounds.x1 and bounds.y2-bounds.y1 respectively, then page.width/page.height are updated to the maximum observed values.
If page.width or page.height is zero after scanning, page is set from PSPageGeometry; if image_info->page is non-NULL, page is then overridden by image_info->page.
If no delegate is found for the selected mode, the function destroys the image and returns NULL.
After delegate selection, if page.width or page.height is zero, page is set from PSPageGeometry; if image_info->page is non-NULL, page is then overridden by image_info->page.
page.width and page.height are scaled by image->resolution.x/delta.x and image->resolution.y/delta.y respectively, with delta initialized to DefaultResolution.
If ReadImage returns NULL, the function throws a DelegateError and does not continue to the image list processing loop.
If the resulting image magick is BMP, ConsolidateCMYKImages is attempted; if it returns non-NULL, the original image list is destroyed and replaced.
If image_info->ping is true, image dimensions are scaled by resolution/2.0 during the final image list loop.
